items.quote: Lavar is a fabulous handyman. Prompt , attention to detail. Honest and best of all such a nice guy. He put down a new floor in my upstairs. I was refereed to by a friend and couldn't be happier..
Call Lavar you'll be extremely happy! Not because he knows how to do everything, but because of the experience you'll have with him! Great guy 100% reccomended!! Thanks for hanging my tv looks great!

Lavar has been a god send . Both my neighbor and I hire him regularly for all our handyman needs . He is professional , skilled , fair , punctual and has excellent customer service . On top of all that he has an artistic eye which can help with making some design decisions as he does his handyman work . Highly recommend .
